newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - Aug 6.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - Aug 6.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 10.91 2 points or 0.13 percent to close at 8187.54
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index plunged 33.48 points or 3.42 percent to 945.08, battered by short-selling of stocks following curbs imposed by the central bank on swap transactions.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.6400/30 a dollar at around 0046 GMT, against 2.6340/70 at its Kuala Lumpur ending on Tuesday.
* Market expected to extend yesterday's fall, analysts said. Poor sentiment and uncertainty over ringgit direction will hamper a rebound.
* "It will still come down. Yesterday at the day's end there was no sign of a rebound," said Pong Teng Swee, assistant research manager at Seagroatt & Campbell.

* "I think there may be a technical rebound today or tommorrow, with immediate support at 920. If it breaks, then it will dip below 900," said Ooi Soon Beng, head of research at Inter-Pacific Capital.
* Shares of automotive parts maker Autoindustries Ventures Bhd list on the Second Board of the exchange, with shares offered to the public at 2.90 ringgit.
